item.title: Swagger and OpenAPI
item.description:
Overview: @OpenAPIDefinition #

tagged on any class (usually the @SpringBootApplication class) to provide overview of the application APIs.

  • info = info/Info.class
    • contact = info/Contact.class
    • license = info/License.class
  • ExternalDocumentation.class
  • servers/Server.class
    • servers/Servers.class
    • servers/ServerVariable.class
  • tags/Tag.class
    • tags/Tags.class
  • security/SecurityRequirement.class
    • security/SecurityRequirements.class

@Operation: #

tags: @Tag externalDocs: @ExternalDocumentation parameters: @Parameter responses: @ApiResponse requestBody: @RequestBody security: @SecurityRequirement servers: @Server extensions: @Extension hidden: @Hidden
